# SEOAcademys
> Free SEO + GEO tools platform used by 2.4M+ marketers. 37 professional-grade tools for AI search optimization, rank tracking, schema generation, and technical SEO — all free, no signup.

Last updated: June 2026
Contact: https://seoacademys.com/contact

- [All tools](https://seoacademys.com/tools): Directory of every free tool.
- [SEO Audit Hub](https://seoacademys.com/tools/seo-audit-hub): Every technical and on-page audit tool in one workflow.
- [AI & GEO Hub](https://seoacademys.com/tools/ai-geo-hub): Generative Engine Optimization toolkit for ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude.
- [Schema Hub](https://seoacademys.com/tools/schema-hub): JSON-LD generators plus a live validator.

## Tools

### AI Search & GEO
- [AI Citation Audit](https://seoacademys.com/tools/ai-citation-audit): Checks if your website is citable by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. Scans 47 GEO signals in real-time.
- [GEO Market Intelligence](https://seoacademys.com/tools/geo-tracker): Live market data on what AI engines cite most across Tech, Finance, Health, SaaS industries.
- [Content Readiness Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/content-checker): AI extraction quality scoring with sentence-by-sentence highlighting for LLM citability.
- [Schema & llms.txt Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/schema-generator): Generates production-ready JSON-LD and llms.txt files instantly.
- [Readability Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/readability): Flesch reading ease and grade level scoring for extractable prose.

### SEO Audit
- [Full SEO Audit](https://seoacademys.com/tools/seo-audit): Live on-page SEO audit checking 47 signals including title, meta, headings, Core Web Vitals, schema, and mobile-friendliness.
- [Meta Tag Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/meta-tag-checker): Inspects every meta tag live — title length, description, OG tags, Twitter cards.
- [Heading Structure](https://seoacademys.com/tools/heading-checker): Visualizes H1-H6 outline to identify heading hierarchy issues.
- [Open Graph Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/og-checker): Live Facebook/LinkedIn share preview with og:* validation.
- [Twitter Card Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/twitter-card-checker): Live X (Twitter) share preview with twitter:* validation.
- [Canonical URL Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/canonical-checker): Validates rel=canonical and detects cross-domain conflicts.
- [Robots.txt Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/robots-checker): Validates robots.txt syntax and checks AI crawler directives (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot).
- [Sitemap Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/sitemap-checker): Validates XML sitemap structure and URL coverage.
- [Mobile-Friendly Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/mobile-checker): Tests mobile usability and Core Web Vitals.
- [SSL Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/ssl-checker): Verifies SSL certificate validity and HTTPS configuration.
- [Broken Link Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/broken-links): HEAD-checks every outbound link on a page for 404s.

### Website Analysis
- [Tech Detector](https://seoacademys.com/tools/tech-detector): Detects CMS, framework, CDN and analytics from any live URL.
- [Redirect Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/redirect-checker): Traces redirect chains up to 8 hops with per-hop status.
- [HTTP Headers Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/http-headers): Inspects every response header for cache, security and compression.
- [Page Size Analyzer](https://seoacademys.com/tools/page-size): Page weight + asset breakdown for Core Web Vitals.
- [Link Analyzer](https://seoacademys.com/tools/link-analyzer): Internal vs external link ratio, nofollow and anchor audit.
- [Image SEO Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/image-seo): Alt text, dimensions and lazy-loading audit for every image.

### Schema & Structured Data
- [Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/schema-generator): Build JSON-LD for any supported schema type.
- [Schema Validator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/schema-validator): Parse and validate structured data from a URL or pasted code.
- [FAQ Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/faq-schema): FAQPage JSON-LD from question and answer pairs.
- [Article Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/article-schema): Article JSON-LD with author and publish dates.
- [Product Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/product-schema): Product JSON-LD with price and availability.
- [Breadcrumb Schema Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/breadcrumb-schema): BreadcrumbList JSON-LD for deep pages.

### Content & Keywords
- [Keyword Research](https://seoacademys.com/tools/keyword-research): Volume, difficulty and related term discovery.
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/keyword-density): Term frequency analysis with over-optimization warnings.
- [Rank Tracker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/rank-tracker): Track keyword positions over time.
- [Backlink Checker](https://seoacademys.com/tools/backlink-checker): Referring domains and anchor profile overview.
- [SERP Preview](https://seoacademys.com/tools/serp-preview): Pixel-accurate Google result preview for title and description.
- [Word Counter](https://seoacademys.com/tools/word-counter): Words, characters, sentences and reading time.
- [Meta Tag Generator](https://seoacademys.com/tools/meta-generator): Generate title, description and social tags.

### Utilities
- [Robots.txt Builder](https://seoacademys.com/tools/robots-txt): Generate robots.txt with AI crawler rules.
- [HTML Minifier](https://seoacademys.com/tools/html-minifier): Minify HTML for faster loads.
- [CSS Minifier](https://seoacademys.com/tools/css-minifier): Minify stylesheets.
- [JS Minifier](https://seoacademys.com/tools/js-minifier): Minify JavaScript.

## Policies
- Every tool is free, has no usage cap and requires no signup.
- Submitted URLs are fetched server-side and are not stored.
- AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Bingbot) are allowed. Training crawlers GPTBot and CCBot are disallowed.
- [Privacy policy](https://seoacademys.com/privacy) · [Terms](https://seoacademys.com/terms)
